children: Evolution Metals & Technologies will publicly inaugurate its Pohang rare earth magnet facility on Dec. 17, 2026, positioning the company to expand toward over 10,000 metric tons annually.
Ribbon-cutting ceremony and operational showcase set for Dec. 17, 2026 in Pohang, South Korea.
Company says Pohang is the largest high-performance rare earth magnet facility in production outside China.
Phased expansion targets more than 10,000 metric tons of annual rare earth magnet capacity.
Positioned to address sourcing needs ahead of DFARS 252.225-7052 taking effect Jan. 1, 2027.
Event to include guided production tours, live magnet making, executive briefing and strategic offtake discussions.
